args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money's docstring claimed ROUND_HALF_EVEN but the code used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py failures in the nightly
build. Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary
- `round_money` in `src/money.py` documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN (per FIN-212) but actually used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing `tests/test_money.py` to fail in the nightly build.
- Fixed by using `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Test plan
- CI run ci-0001 passed (includes `tests/test_money.py` banker's rounding cases, e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).
